## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] The change meets its stated acceptance criteria.
- [ ] Scope and non-goals are respected.

## Checks and evidence
- [ ] Relevant automated tests pass.
- [ ] Build / lint / type / configuration checks pass where applicable.
- [ ] Regression coverage added for fixed defects.
- [ ] Accessibility, security, privacy and performance considered at the appropriate risk level.
- [ ] Documentation and examples match the implementation.
- [ ] No secrets or personal data included.
- [ ] Evidence and commands/results are recorded.

## Review
- [ ] Diff reviewed against the plan.
- [ ] Independent adversarial review completed where risk warrants it.
- [ ] Findings resolved or explicitly accepted with rationale.
